help.fetch_archive: Import a pinned local update archive

help.lang: Language of help, output and errors; default: LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG, then the system language
help.launch_note: Disabled launch subsystems do not start a VM.
help.machine_path_note:
MACHINE_PATH is an existing relative or absolute machine directory containing
runtime.json. Its profile and machine identity are inferred. Voyemu locates its
installation automatically; no --root, --profile or --machine is needed.
Each machine directory holds at most one active session. Commands reject an
active session from a different machine directory, even with the same profile.
Normal start reads launch configuration; check performs the integrity audit.
help.network: Outbound NAT for the guest; default: no
help.preparation_note:
Build destination must be a new immediate directory in this installation's
machines folder: machines/NAME or its absolute path. Existing machines remain.
help.restart: Validate the selection, stop it, then launch again
help.resume: Copy the saved vehicle scenario instead of defaults
help.reuse_qnx: Reuse unchanged accepted Free 7.3.1 QNX closure for build
help.reuse_qnx_source: Same-pin QNX payload directory, paired with receipt
help.run: Run and control a prepared machine
help.stop: Stop the selected session and its guest processes
help.subsystems_note:
At least one subsystem must be enabled. Build defaults to both.
